notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.0c
notes.notes:
This is a tiny update, that sadly ended up being rather over-sized on disk :(

So. What happened? 
Traditionally Unity sets all imported images as DXTC1 or DXTC5 compressed textures. These have a lot of advantages in terms of loading speed and in-memory size, but they are rather heavily compressed. That's a tradeoff we're usually fine in with Textures used for 3D images, but it can be an issue with 2D images (which is the way I'm using it).

I made a test-case changing it all to lossless compression (so the images don't get any 'jpeg' style artifacts), and I decided it was worth doing that across all the platforms once and for all. I hadn't fully appreciated just how much work was involved in that :)

So far, Love of Magic, Morningstar and Wings of Empire have all gotten the decompression treatment. Across 3 platforms (Windows, Mac and Linux), At 10-16 GB/platform/game (~200-250GB in total), my poor PC's gotten a real workout. But it's done.

TL;DR: sorry it's such a big download, though hopefully it should improve image quality a bit, and remove unwanted compression artifacts.

I'm hoping no further issues show up with Morningstar or Love of Magic, letting me focus fully down on Wings of Empire. Ad Astra per Aspera.

notes.title: Game+ Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/1f25e2117161922a9d75367b56b7108fbc648da5.png[/img]

I had dreams of a little Game+ mode. It would let you play past the end of the game, Initially inspired by Snowdrop's Movie Shoot (which spawned a couple of social media posts and a Demonfox article if you completed it), I ended up adding a bunch of post-game content more or less by accident.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/0afe8b80ed36b78f5e4177695aa13a8967fb4cd8.png[/img]

Snowdrop, Lin and Ciara all chime in on titter, and some different Demonfox articles trigger, depending on what ending and sidequests you picked. Most of them aren't related to the Path of Light (where New York ceases to be your problem), so I'd mostly recommend playing them with a save that's finished the Path of Fire + Lin and Snowdrop's side-content. 

Load the End of Game save, and you'll find yourself teleported back to the Last Drop and Day 115. You can complete various side-quests, test your match three abilities in the maze, and check out the new content.

I had initally written a goodbye to Lin on Day 113, but ended up cutting it. Instead I added it back on day 115+. The Path of Light farewell is a little melancholy, but there's not really space for her in the life he intends to live. 

I WAS going to write something similar for Path of Fire, but I'd forgotten that Lin is a master of breaking lose from whatever narrative restrictions I place on her. Originally envisioned as an extra without any speaking lines she ended up charming her way into one of the four endings. It makes sense that she'd turn her farewell into a steaming threesome with Katie instead. Utterly unplanned but I had a blast making it. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/06e0f66d8f9391ed697ef8083c34bdc302a29568.png[/img]

I also wanted to do a little with Sophia; again a Path of Fire questline (cheating on one Arch Angel with another seems like a bad idea) you get to meet up with Sophia and renew your... friendship. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/5e87292d22b35b1e26adab3c0dc7f876af656227.png[/img]
(The bottle is of course a callout to Love of Magic's Book 2, where Katie Maclachlan, the Duchess of Lancaster, serves her brand new moonshine at MC's wedding). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/42e8d2d1bd78ef13d718b9c2a060976df3674498.png[/img]
Speaking of Love of Magic, Book 2 got it's NG+ update today. Adds in several new events with Kath, Bella, Molly, Akane and Emily, updates the engine to the final Book 3 engine, and adds in a big new NG+ only questline called What was Promised.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/bcd7cd896d611c908aece20ad789cf83076fc6be.jpg[/img]

Which gets me to what I'm working on next. Wings of Empire is a space opera set in a world where the Roman Empire never fell, but clawed its way to the stars. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/709bd1f247ee9a2b5d4ac4a2a13478d618045cb0.png[/img]
You were a Centurion in the Legion Special Forces before a plasma bolt ended your career. Unwilling to quit you signed up as a Fighter Pilot, and as a fresh Lieutenant you board the Fast Attack Carrier Aquila as it prepares to head into the Dark. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/7638732a5533660a8af91d4eb81c6280a342a916.png[/img]

Wings of Empire is inspired by my love for epic space opera, like the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honorverse]Honorverse[/url], [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Lost_Fleet]The Lost Fleet[/url], The [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alliance%E2%80%93Union_universe]Alliance-Union Universe[/url] and many others. It also draws inspiration from SciFi and anime movies and series, from Space Battleship Yamato to Starship Troopers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43997835/7e0b87be341549f6a8e06bb1c8506b6e757b5cea.png[/img]

Would you like to know more? The first 13 days of Wings of Empire is available on the Development Beta Branch of Morningstar. You can activate it like this:

https://morningstarvn.fandom.com/wiki/Technical

When you now start the game you will be prompted to start either Morningstar or Wings of Empire. 
It will sit on the Development Branch until it's enters Early Access, sometime in 2025. 

Sounds interesting? PLEASE give it a wishlist, so it can have the best chance of succeeding at launch. Wishlists are a sign to Steam's algorithm that this is a real game, and in return the Algorithm shows it to more people at launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3203710/Wings_of_Empire/

Want to know more? Come join us on [url=https://discord.gg/NQrQrht]Discord [/url]for fun discussions about History, Redheads and theorycrafting. Come for the pretty girls, stay for the story and the awesome community!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Tiny fix, but since it resolves a potential soft-lock I decided to promote it to the default branch. Basically you could get the game into a situation where you couldn't leave the room (NO_EXIT flag set), if you told Katie you wanted to do PT (which sets the flag, and places MC in the room), then clicked on Lin afterwards (which starts her sequence, not the intended PT converation). 

Small thing, but it solves the issue some people had with getting stuck. 
I also restored the ability to edit your fight-name in the Stats app, which had been accidentally removed.

1.0.5
- Fixed a bug that could leave the NO_EXIT flag on after a gym event
- Fixed a bug where the fight name wasn't available to reset on the Stats app

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.notes:
This is primarily a Steamdeck release, which fixes the blocking text-input problem on the device.

It also cleans up some font issues, resolved some spank-bank problems and fixed situation where you could skip night-time activities by playing the maze and exiting using the card, rather than the UI.

1.0.4
- Fixed some font atlases having dirty alpha channels
- Fixed exiting the Maze at night using the end-card not triggering the night-time event if it is present
- Fixed Treasure or Trouble not paying out a reward

1.0.3
- Fixed login screen on SteamDeck
- Did a pass to regenerate the font-textures to hopefully fix invalid font-assets

1.0.2
- Typo pass
- Fixed one of Lin's spank-bank scenes not unlocking properly, and another being a duplicate
- Fixed text-entry on the Steam Deck

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1d
notes.notes:
This bug-fix release mainly deals with a pretty bad bug that meant that you could break story progression by running the Maze at night (skipping any pre-planned night-time activities). Apart from that it adds some missing spank-bank entries, and cleans up some chunk-based achievements. 

1.0.1d
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to skip night-time events by running the maze or going to the shooting range

1.0.1c
- Fixed a visual glitch with one of Geekboy's facial expression
- Added a guard to stop the weapons UI breaking if there's an invalid skill associated
- Fixes Emily's date 8 not saving to the spank bank
- Fixed Ciara's day 98 event not saving to the spank bank
- Fixed some typos in Quest descriptions
- Djinn swaps out Vulcanic blast for Rage
- Fixed Sophia's rest-stop conversation being repeatable
- Fixed a bug where spending the timeslot immediately before a night-time event at the shooting range would skip the event
- Fixed a bug where all the chunk-based achievements could risk not triggering one element

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
A huge thanks to all the players finding and letting me know about issues (and typos). This update deals with some achievement bugs people have reported (Man of Culture, specifically), some potential timeline problems (where things unlock out of order, or show up incorrectly on some paths) and some quality of life issues. 

Full build notes:


1.0.1
- Fixed an issue where rewind data isn't fully cleared between loads, which could cause issues combining loading and rollback

1.0.0h
- Fixed an issue where some Scene Replay files wouldn't replay properly.
- DSLR camera was showing cost of $300 in the app, but only cost $150 when you bought it. Fixed the app view so they're both $150.
- Fixed Man Of Culture achievement, and added a fail-safe to validate it when you re-enter the Achievement UI

1.0.0g
- Fixed forward skip not skipping past meaningful choices
- Restored the old auto-skip functionality (accidentally disabled in 1.0.0f)
- Fixed a bug where keyboard skipping works after end of login/enter name without explicitly losing focus

1.0.0f
- Gun Range now pays out bonus cash
- Enter can be used to skip forward (same as space)
- Re-ordered 3 of Snowdrop's Teets for timeline integrity

1.0.0e
- Fixed the visualization of additional XP in the Stats tracker and quick-stats UI giving the correct % increase
- Fixed a bug where applying rage would cause the counter to freeze

1.0.0d
- Fixed an issue if two competing notifications fire simultanously
- Fixed a bug where you could edit your fight name in the Stats App before assigning it
- Make sure Kelly's first PT session correctly increments the counter
- Made it easier to access Lin's first visit to the Last Drop, day 18
- Emily no longer fights for coffee-time with the Pre-Fight Katja dialog

1.0.0c
- Fixed an issue where repeated applications of the shield could break the animation
- Fixed an issue where the Djinn could regenerate her shield while Regen was active
- Rage counter now visually counts down at the beginning of turn
- Spellchecking pass

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0b
notes.notes:
A huge thanks to everyone reporting issues, here's a quick hotfix with all known issues resolved.

Most of the issues are small, or quality of life improvements. One issue that some people reported was being able to skip the second half of Day 18s party (if you spoke to your Coach last); that's been tracked down and resolved.

1.0.0b
- Flicker jab reduced in cost, increased in power
- Fixed a bug in weight lifting achievement (should be at least 10x, not 20x)
- Fixed an issue where you backspace twice while naming a character would auto-select the name 
- Stopped interacting with the underlying cards while the conversation is open in the Maze
- Gun range practice now advances time
- Stat tracker on your phone now gives more information about what the stats do
- Fixed one of the calendar events overflowing the text box
- Fixed a bug where talking to Coach last on day 18 would skip the final event in the bar.
- Fixed the Black Widow being misnamed in the Daemonfox pages
- Typo pass
